summary_en: RAKUS authorized acquisition of up to 3.6 million shares (1.02% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of JPY 3.0 billion through market purchases from November 16 to December 18, 2026, with all acquired shares to be cancelled on December 30, 2026, to improve capital efficiency and return capital to shareholders.
title_en: Notice regarding determination of matters concerning acquisition of treasury shares and determination of matters concerning cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, RAKUS's board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury shares and their cancellation. The company will acquire up to 3.6 million common shares, representing 1.02% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026), for a maximum aggregate consideration of JPY 3.0 billion. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases via a discretionary trading agreement from November 16 through December 18, 2026.

All shares acquired under this authorization will be cancelled as a matter of policy, with the cancellation scheduled to take effect on December 30, 2026. The company cited two objectives for this capital allocation decision: improvement of capital efficiency and return of capital to shareholders. As of September 30, 2026, RAKUS held 273,406 treasury shares against 354,117,594 outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock).
